title: Tinubu Signs New NIMC Act, Sets National Identity Enrollment Deadline
detail: President Tinubu signed the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC) Act 2026 into law on June 26, repealing the 2007 NIMC legislation. The new law updates the legal framework governing the National Identification Number (NIN) system and comes alongside a presidential directive ordering NIMC to enroll all Nigerians, with a 2026 completion deadline. The push is aimed at closing gaps in national identity coverage that have hampered welfare targeting, tax administration, and financial inclusion efforts.

media.caption: Tinubu signs the new NIMC Act 2026 and orders full national identity enrollment
